{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter

# Test: preview before any apply, then direct insert
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w = BatchWriter(db)

# Preview should return [1] for empty db
ids = w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'a': 1}}])
print(f'Preview on empty: {ids}')
assert ids == [1], f'Expected [1], got {ids}'

# Direct insert
db.insert({'b': 2})
print(f'After direct insert: {db.all()}')

# Preview should return [2] since doc 1 exists
ids = w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'c': 3}}])
print(f'Preview after direct insert: {ids}')
assert ids == [2], f'Expected [2], got {ids}'

# Apply should also return [2]
ids = w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'c': 3}}])
print(f'Apply after direct insert: {ids}')
assert ids == [2], f'Expected [2], got {ids}'

print(f'Final state: {db.all()}')
print('ALL TESTS PASSED')
"
